summary: Otter Tail Corp filed an 8-K Item 1.01 reporting entry into a settlement agreement to resolve putative class action claims in the PVC Pipe Antitrust Litigation. Two subsidiaries agreed to pay an aggregate $30 million into a settlement fund for the End-User Class, with payment due ~21 days after preliminary court approval. The settlement is not a special situation; it is a routine litigation resolution. The company does not admit wrongdoing and expects to use available cash. No deal terms apply. The filing is not classified under any special-situations category.
